subject: ssh
what: Hardens the OpenSSH daemon for named-user key-only login over the mesh VPN.
why: Prevents password guessing and restricts administrative access to explicit human accounts.
risk: high: misconfiguration can lock out remote logins; guarded by a dead-man timer.
undo: Run wskit ssh revert --apply to restore the backed-up sshd drop-in and firewall rules.
manual_equivalent: Install /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/50-agent-workstation-kit.conf, run sshd -t and reload ssh.
